newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Novus says Wunut field to go ahead.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Novus says Wunut field to go ahead.

text.p: Novus Petroleum Ltd said on Wednesday that commercial terms had been reached for the $US30 million first phase development of the Wunut gas field in Indonesia.
Novus earlier reported a net profit for the year to December 31, 1996 of A$19.5 million, after a A$1.4 million exploration write-off.
Excluding the write-off, Novus said the result represented a five-percent increase on the prospectus forecast following its float two years ago.

Managing director Bob Williams said development of the onshore Wunut field in the Brantas production sharing contract in East Java would involve the supply of 105 billion cubic feet of gas over 15 years.
Further development would depend on the success of the first phase and any add-ons through exploration.
Williams said Novus had increased its interest in the Brantas PSC from 40 percent to 50 percent at no cost following a series of equity transactions.
The other 50 percent of the block is held by operators Lapindo Brantas Inc, a subsidiary of Indonesia's privately-owned Bakrie Group.
Novus shares were seven cents higher at $2.93 at 11.05 a.m. (0005 GMT).
